messages:
alex.k: Hey team — trying to pull the APAC model-latency heatmap and service overview for model-serving-staging but Grafana 403s for me. Anyone got a shortlink?
maya: Which Grafana cluster? apac grafana or global? The model tiles are in the model-health dashboard.
alex.k: apac (apac-grafana.internal). I used https://grafana.company/apac/d/model-health but got `403 Forbidden`.
eng-sre-bot: Access check: user alex.k not in group grafana-viewers-apac. To request access, open https://idp.company/access and request 'dash-viewer:apac' OR ping #eng-sre with the request. (automated)
jin: @alex.k I've added a temporary read token to the team vault — DM me if you need it for a quick look. For long-term, request the IAM group.
alex.k: thanks @jin — quick Q: where is the model latency heatmap (by model version)? I only see overall p95.
maya: It's on the same dashboard: section 'model latency by model' -> panel 4. Shortlink: go/rwd-dash/model-latency (internal). If you still can't open, try this Loki query for recent tail:
maya: ```
{job="model-ingest"} |= "latency_ms" | json | unwrap latency_ms | line_format "latency=%s"
```
leo: Also, if you want alert tuning: which alert? p95-latency-apac-prod? If staging only, we'd add a new rule group 'staging-model-slo' — open a tiny PR in infra/alerts and ping me.
alex.k: Got the panel now, thanks. I'll open a PR later. One more — any tips to reduce noise? p95 flickers a lot during deploys.
jin: add a `for: 5m` to the rule and require node_count > 3 and exclude deploy window with label `deployment=rolling`. Simple change in prometheus rules. :thumbsup: 
alex.k: perfect, thanks all :heart: 
eng-sre-bot: Note: this thread referenced go/rwd-dash/model-latency and infra/alerts. Remember to include runbook link in your PR.
